2. Sample Data for Initial Load.


PRODUCT_TYPE='UD013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' will be updated on the next run. 
PRODUCT_TYPE='32005' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP' will be deleted from the source on the next run .
PRODUCT_TYPE='00013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed.
PRODUCT_TYPE='9999' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table).

SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='UD013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' AND SCD_END_DATE='99991231'
UNION ALL
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='32005' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP' AND SCD_END_DATE='99991231'
UNION ALL
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='00013' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='DEP' AND SCD_END_DATE='99991231'
UNION ALL
SELECT PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE2,NIM_FPAD NIM_FPAD2, * FROM
EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING WHERE PRODUCT_TYPE='9999' AND  BANK_CODE='CBC01'  AND  SOURCE_CODE='LNS' AND SCD_END_DATE='99991231'
